instruction: A cluster mailbox unit: a freestanding metal cabinet on a post/pedestal, a front face gridded into many small individual locked compartment doors with handles, one or two larger parcel-locker doors below, and a peaked rain hood on top. Postal grey.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a cluster mailbox unit. A cluster mailbox unit: a freestanding metal cabinet on a post/pedestal, a front face gridded into many small individual locked compartment doors with handles, one or two larger parcel-locker doors below, and a peaked rain hood on top. Postal grey. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
